title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache parallelism
author: Ava Patel
description: Motivation: Our CI has accumulated multiple ad-hoc workflows for linting, unit/integration tests, and release automation which made maintenance and cache usage inefficient. This PR consolidates core lint/test/release pipelines into a smaller set of reusable workflow templates, reduces duplicated GH Actions logic, and implements improved cache parallelism to speed job startup and reduce redundant artifact downloads. Key goals: 1) unify lint/test/release flows to reduce maintenance overhead and surface area for flakes; 2) improve build matrix cache behavior to reduce cold-cache job latency; 3) keep release automation behavior unchanged for callers and release artifacts. Changes included: consolidated workflows under .github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/release.yml; introduced .github/actions/cache-helpers for cache priming/restore logic; standardized node/pip/multi-language setup steps; moved shared steps into reusable workflows; added feature flags to opt into parallel cache restore when supported. Checklist: - [x] consolidate lint/test workflows - [x] add reusable workflow templates and action for cache helpers - [x] validate releases still trigger correctly - [x] update documentation and docs/developer/ci.md - [x] run full repo CI and fix failing flakes Notes: Some flaky integration tests were observed on initial run due to racey local dev env setup; tests were addressed by adding a small retry wrapper in test setup and increasing timeout for env provisioning. No breaking API or artifact name changes were introduced.
commits: consolidate: move lint/test/release entries into single ci.yml and release.yml
feat(actions): add cache-helpers action with parallel restore/prime helpers
fix(tests): add retry wrapper for flaky integration env provisioning
docs: update developer CI docs and release notes examples
review_comments: Liam Chen: Can we drop node 14 matrix entries as part of this? They still show up in package.json matrix. Response (Ava): Good catch — removed legacy Node 14 jobs and updated matrix to node 16/18/20 in a follow-up commit.

Maya Rodriguez: I saw one flaky integration test fail on the first run. Did you add retries globally or targeted? Response (Ava): Targeted the provisioning step only and added a small retry wrapper to the fixture; left assertions unchanged.

Jonah Smith: Cache priming looks good but we should gate parallel restore behind a flag until GH Actions runners are stable. Response (Ava): Added a repo-level boolean input defaulting to false; we enabled it for internal infra-heavy repos first.
CI: initial run failed due to a linting rule (no-unified-default-export) in package.json changes. Fixed in commit 3 and reran. CI: subsequent run passed (all checks green).
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows and added cache helper action to improve CI startup time and reduce redundant downloads. No changes to public release artifacts. Recommend enabling cache parallelism flag gradually.
